query:
SELECT 
  pc.id,
  pc.parentProductId,
  pc.childProductId,
  p.name as child_name,
  pc.quantity
FROM productCompositions pc
LEFT JOIN products p ON pc.childProductId = p.id
WHERE pc.parentProductId = (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Dose Tanqueray%' AND name NOT LIKE '%Teste%' LIMIT 1)
